# factset for Claude Code

Qualify native PKCE/DCR and the actual redirect; requested provider scopes are openid, mcp and email. Dataset access follows the signed-in FactSet account entitlements. Read-only tools do not grant trading or write access. Preserve source attribution and licensed-content redistribution restrictions; do not infer entitlement from successful authentication.

Install only from the native marketplace. Native authentication, account entitlements and live behavior remain unverified. The source README linked in the banner records evidence; its Cursor/Grok client assumptions do not transfer.
